changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: Written range of the instruments, as MIDI note numbers in the main transposition of the instrument: both values or none, the lowest not above the highest.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE instrument ADD CONSTRAINT ck_instrument_written_range CHECK ( (lowest_written_pitch IS NULL) = (highest_written_pitch IS NULL) AND (lowest_written_pitch IS NULL OR (lowest_written_pitch BETWEEN 0 AND 127 AND highest_written_pitch BETWEEN 0 AND 127 AND lowest_written_pitch <= highest_written_pitch)) );

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE instrument DROP CONSTRAINT ck_instrument_written_range;

changeSet.comment: Version of another part a part was derived from for a different instrument. Versions are only soft-deleted, and the cleanup keeps the versions parts derive from.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_sheet_music_derived_from_version ON sheet_music (derived_from_version_id) WHERE derived_from_version_id IS NOT NULL;
